card.title: Properly Initiated
card.instruction: Treat correct participation in the ritual as proof you deserve to belong. Watch for cues, copy the form, and overcommit to every step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My first choir concert. I bowed when you did. Was that enough to count me in?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Of course. Take another bow; they're still clapping.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll stay down until you rise. I don't want to short-change the choir.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm staying down because my shoe's untied. Go and join the others.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll retie mine too. Then we can finish my first bows exactly together.

mechanism: A uses matching bows as proof of choir membership and copies an unrelated shoe action rather than break ritual synchrony.
confusable: Unlike merely following social enthusiasm, A's belonging depends on exact participation in a named formal act.
comparison: The choir alternative mistakes a shoe delay for a bow requirement; the dinner alternative supports a hurting participant to maintain the prescribed standing period.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
